
# **Tipping Study - pt.5 GAM modeling of trajectory x-component**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)
```

#### Data

```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "04_out.rdata"))
```

Model setup
---

#### Set contrasts

```{r}
model_data$hand_used <- relevel(
  model_data$hand_used,
  ref = "right"
)

model_data$distractor_side <- relevel(
  model_data$distractor_effector,
  ref = "Same"
)

model_data$distractor_pos <- relevel(
  model_data$distractor_pos,
  ref = "Palmar"
)

model_data$which_hand <- relevel(
  model_data$which_hand,
  ref = "Dominant"
)
```

#### Define & run model

```{r}
formula_m1 <- hand_x ~
  distractor_side * hand_used * side_used +
  s(trajectory, bs = "re") +
  s(participant, bs = "re")
```

```{r}
dt$trajectory <- as.factor(dt$trajectory)
pids <- sample(unique(dt$participant), 20)
model_data <- dt[participant %in% pids]
m1 <- gam(formula_m1, data = model_data)
```

> [!Note]
> Attempts to fit the model with a more faithful effects structure failed due to memory constraints.
> Alternatively, I might not know what I am doing.

---

```{r}
save(m1, file = here::here("data", "proc", "05_out.rdata"))
```
